sourceFile: 38. BRS-161014 Report test dry final SPK_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft incorrectly merges several independent experiments into one changed factor and uses invalid cross-condition pairings.
issues: Multiple distinct reports/experiments are grouped as one factor.
Waiting 12H pairs ignore test round, date, and drop-test status.
Dry final 80C, tray dry, laser, bonding, UC press, and waiting changes need separate factors or cases.
Measurement outcomes mix headers/function counts with tray height data and are not reliable.
Some cited rows are headers or absent from supplied context, not sufficient evidence.
correctionPlan: Split review cases or changed factors by sheet/report and changed condition.
Rebuild comparisons only within matching date/test round/drop status/baseline context.
For Waiting 12H, include Test 1/Test 2 rows with their matching Normal rows and conclusion row.
For Dry final and tray dry, separate function NG-rate outcomes from tray height before/after outcome.
Remove generic measurement stats unless tied to explicit before/after or control/test rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are not sufficient until grouped per comparable factor and outcome.
